GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 3 lengths. 2nd turn 4 lengths. ran on strongly # just too strong
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. looking for run turn 4 lengths. got to outside 300 metres. ran on well # pulled up lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped rnr. When quest re settling further back rider stated that her intention was to race further fwd but after beginning awk her mount didn’t show enough speed early to establish a more fwd position and ultimately was obliged to settle a little worse than midfield. A post-race vet exam revealed the filly to be lame (grade 4/5) in the N/H leg subseq diagnosed with a pelvic fracture. Has completed all req's under the Racing Australia Code Of Practice for the return to racing including having barrier trialled at Canberra on 20/2/26.
